% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): a scope around the axis (behaviour
% AC1): its line width and `draw=` do not reach the axis; its colour and
% dash pattern do.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{scope}[semithick, blue, densely dashed, draw=green]
\begin{axis}[xmin=-1, xmax=2, ymin=0, ymax=3, xlabel=X, axis lines=left]
\addplot+[mark=square*] coordinates {(-1,0.5) (0,1) (1,2.5) (2,2)};
\addplot[black] coordinates {(-1,2) (2,0.5)};
\draw (axis cs:0,0.2) -- (axis cs:1.5,0.2);
\end{axis}
\end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
